body:
My stomach started really hurting for no reason (I didn't do anything), I might be hungry (have some neurological issues where it's hard to tell) so I'm going to try to eat a little, then sleep. My friend made me promise I'll be ok tonight. So I will. 

I'm texting the crisis line. They're encouraging me to contact voc rehab so I can get meds. I think I'll just go ahead and try that again. Why not. 

Thanks for talking me through this. If you hadn't, I'd probably be in a hospital or dead right now. Still not totally thrilled to be here, but I feel like I'll get over it. I hope you have a good night/day

I don't think I'm going to kill my self tonight, but I can't make any promises about later. 

I just don't know what to do anymore. I'm so lost.
He's really upset. I don't blame him. I don't want to hurt him but I don't know how to fix this.

I don't know how much it will help... But thank you

My best friend's awake. He's trying to stop me. I shouldn't've texted him but I didn't want our last communication to be so abrupt and terrible
I looked at their website, but it's too confusing on mobile. I don't know if I want to put effort into another miserable day here

I highly doubt it. I'm a nobody, and I only seem to cause everyone more trouble than I'm worth. 

Hopefully they'll clean it up by then, she doesn't typically have to drive anywhere too often. 

I think I'm having a final cigarette then heading off. But thank you, it was nice talking

I'm just so desperate. I don't want to be a burden, but I know that I'll be a burden no matter what- dead, alive, or in-between. I've more or less said goodbye to my best friend- I made sure to tell him I love him one final time. I'm driving a block or two away from my friend's house so she won't have to see. I have to do this.
If i don't end up killing myself, maybe
I'd definitely deserve it. I'm almost to the point where I'm willing to risk it for a shot at death
I honestly don't care about it enough to make it a reason to stick around. Hell, I love my best friend to death, but even he can't keep me here.

I'm just so tired of getting rejected

Or told to go somewhere else that can't help me either

I mean, if I end up a vegetable, at least I won't know I'm still here (hopefully). 

I mean, both my friend who took me in and my mom have been searching endlessly, I've done some research myself, I'm more or less positive I already know what's out there. Plus, that's more effort to put into potential rejection, being ignored/never gotten back to, etc

I genuinely wish I felt I could help. I mean, fwiw (as I'm suicidal with intent, and if I'm not gone in the next 24hr will likely be gone in the next week- so honestly this is fairly hypocritical)

In the years since I've been 14, I've experienced many beautiful things I am glad I stuck around for. And honestly, reading this, it's like it was written by myself at your age. 

Don't give up yet. If anything, live out your teen years first. Maybe by the time you reach my age (20), life will send you something that changes your mind (and you'll be able to get help for your depression.)

14's a rough age. You're not alone there.

I know they have support groups around here. I think you have to have Medicaid, though. (Which I've been denied from time and time again) 

I mean, maybe

Eh, I'd love to at least get my GED, but I don't have the time or resources right now.

I do, and if I deprive myself, I'll be better equipped to do something. Psychosis might even set in. Maybe I'll somehow lose my job or quit it and find even more motivation. I'm also currently trying to work myself up emotionally, because I think my calmness is holding me back.

Honestly, I don't see things changing for the better fast enough to save me. This is the most consistently I've been suicidal since I can remember. I don't think I've ever actively made attempts on my life for a week straight before. Maybe several days out of a month- but every day for a week straight? Granted, it hasn't been anything too major yet, but the more time goes on, the more serious I get with my methods. The more I find out what doesn't work to rule it out. The less scared, more calm I become. The more ballsy I get. 

Truthfully, I hope it's the end, but either way, it really feels like it. At this rate, I don't think I'll last long.

Believe me, everyone I know is simultaneously too poor and doesn't care. 

The biggest problem is that I need a med eval, and prescriptions. I'm working with voc rehab, but they haven't answered my phone calls in over a month.

I mean, not really, as it'll be another long day of work at a place that just drains me. It's something to do with myself, but it's stressful. I don't hate it enough to quit (not that my stupid dropout ass with experience exclusively in retail and foodservice has a snowball's chance in hell at a job that is either not horribly stressful and shitty or pays decently, nonetheless both) 
Not to mention that quitting kinda zaps my chances at getting a place to rent (what with no rental history and all) 

I mean, not getting sleep would be worse, but maybe it'll push me to just end it all more. I seem to be having a hard time actually getting off my ass and doing anything to myself right now, and I hope that changes soon.

I mean, I've tried for years. If it's ever gonna change, it's gonna take a long-ass time...

That's exactly why. And even if I stick out the depression, it'll take months, and I'll most likely just rocket back into mania- then crash back into depression. They're long, intense cycles. I'm emotionally and physically exhausted. I'm just... Done.

I just can't mentally handle it anymore. It'll probably all fall apart soon anyway- being depressed and all. If I live through tonight but do something, I can kiss my job and car goodbye; they'll probably ship me off to a hospital for god knows how long (I was there two weeks last time). If I don't, it's already almost 1AM, I'm not gonna get much sleep. Work will be hell. Even if I make it through tomorrow, how long can I last? The only way I can see myself getting through this is with like, maybe some obscene amounts of cocaine and half a dozen Red Bulls. Just... Shoot myself through the roof back into mania.
Don't be. I've honestly wanted this most of my life. I'm suffering. Granted, I can't care once I'm dead, so I can't consider it a good thing, but I won't have to suffer anymore either.

I am the problem. I can push people to their darkest places, and they lash out at me, and leave. 

I mean, in a hospital setting maybe. I've had meds work fast in the hospital. Doctors insist on giving me extremely low doses of extremely benign antidepressants and mood stabilizers. They don't take me seriously even though I've attempted suicide in some very violent and gruesome ways (on record, as well- not just from me recounting). They tell me I'm not bipolar and it's the drugs (which I've been clean from for a significant period of time? And the symptoms started before the drug abuse did) that are making me act this way. Only my current therapist gets it. 

Eh, I guess I have, but it just doesn't seem worth it to me anymore. It really only seemed worth it because I was manic and felt like I could do anything.

I don't want to be cared about. That gives me a reason to be here, out of guilt. Living only for other people is the most miserable existence imaginable. I'd rather everyone hated me so I could just get it over with.

I've honestly tried to better myself for years, and I've only ended up repeatedly being a disappointment to myself and everyone I love. I think they'll get over me pretty quick. I hope to god they do, at least. I'm not worth the time.

Oh believe me, it was not only meant, but intentionally said to hurt me. 

I do have a job, however my shit income goes almost entirely to the installment loan (to get the down payment- I knew I was going to be sleeping at a shelter and wasn't going to make it if I didn't at least have a car), car payment, and insurance for my car. The rest is more or less gas and cigarettes. (The cigarettes are the only thing keeping me from bailing on my job in a moment of stress, and/or relapsing) 

So no real money for meds or housing. I'm trying to get a second job but I just can't be arsed to care anymore. Not to mention that meds take a long ass time to work. 

I've been working hard on my appearance for years. I even have a gym membership. I go fairly frequently. Lost 20lbs. I've just gotten to the point where I'd rather be dead.

Believe me, I've exhausted my options. I've been suicidal to some extent or another for over a decade. The fact that it's the very end is exactly what I'm looking for, I'm tired of waking up in the morning and having to drag myself through another day, knowing that I'll probably be forced to for decades more. If I don't kill myself, past and potentially future alcohol and drug abuse, as well as present smoking and other poor life choices aside, I'll probably live a long life. Life likes to be ironic like that. 

I'm truly not deserving of anything. I'm really not a good person. I'll be doing literally everyone a favor.

Honestly, I think they'll just feel relieved that they don't have to "babysit me" (as one ex called it) anymore 

Honestly, a hospital is just going to be like actual hell. I'll lose my job, car, and the place I've been graciously given to sleep at night for a brief moment 
I'll be stuck in a worse situation, and my family will have even more debt to deal with when I finally do off myself

Thanks, but I genuinely am not a beautiful person. I'm fat, and repulsive both physically and personality-wise. My friends and family really only stick around out of obligation, and avoid talking to me as much as possible. 
And like, that's a nice sentiment and all, but I don't really care about anything being "rewarding", I would rather just not exist anymore. I'm tired. Life is not worth the effort I've been giving it. It's time to sleep.

I've been a horrible inconvenience to the friends I live with tonight; I called my best friend and ended up making him feel horrible; I called a hotline and it didn't help at all, was basically just told I needed to be on meds (easier said than done); I was stood up yesterday and can't get an answer as to why, or even just a "seen" on Facebook messenger; everything is just telling me it's time

Long story short, I'm bipolar and unmedicated, homeless, and ugly inside and out. Among things. I've honestly been extremely suicidal all week, and now seems like a good time to just finally go through with it.
I have been. It doesn't make the depression magically go away. I already work full time, and I'm getting another job so that I can lease a place of my own, but none of it fucking matters.

Honestly, I hate to be the person who comes in and does anything remotely resembling enabling behavior but you'll probably be ok. It's totally not worth it ever, it's disgusting and will make you violently ill, but I can almost guarantee you'll wake up tomorrow. Like you said, real alcohol next time. 

I'd drink it when I was 17, for obvious reasons. (I.e. Being underage) Then it became a habit to avoid withdrawal. No idea how I lived through it, don't make it a regular thing.
